header.title: Textarea
header.description: Multi-line text field with manual or automatic resizing and an optional character counter. It shares the label, messages, borders and info icon with InputText.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Try the main props and copy the generated code.
playground.label: Description
playground.helperText: Drag the corner to resize vertically.

base.title: Base
base.description: Label, placeholder and helper text. By default it shows 3 rows and resizes vertically.

texts.label: Description
texts.helperText: Drag the corner to resize vertically.

withInfoIcon.title: With info icon
withInfoIcon.description: `infoText` adds an info button with a tooltip. It renders in the label row, aligned to the right, so it sits at the top-right corner of the field. `onInfoClick` fires when it is activated.

texts.label: Description
texts.helperText: The icon sits at the top-right when infoText is set.

outlineWithInfoIcon.title: Outline with info icon
outlineWithInfoIcon.description: With `labelPlacement="outline"` there is no label row: the info button sits on the top border, at the right corner of the field.

outlineLabel.title: Outline label
outlineLabel.description: `labelPlacement="outline"` places the label on the top border.

autosize.title: Autosize
autosize.description: `resize="auto"` fits the height to the content between `minRows` and `maxRows`. Past `maxRows` it scrolls.

texts.label: Comment
texts.helperText: Grows with content up to maxRows.
texts.defaultValue: Type more lines to see it grow…

withCounter.title: With counter
withCounter.description: `showCount` together with `maxLength` shows the counter as current / max. It turns red at the limit.

counterOnly.title: Counter only
counterOnly.description: Without `maxLength`, `showCount` only shows the character count.

noResize.title: No resize
noResize.description: `resize="none"` hides the resize handle. `minRows` sets the height.

clearable.title: Clearable
clearable.description: `clearable` shows a button that empties the field while it has a value. It clears through the normal `onChange` path, so it works the same controlled or uncontrolled, and then fires `onClear`. `clearLabel` is the button's accessible name; it defaults to "Clear". The button sits at the top right.

texts.label: Notes
texts.helperText: The button shows while the field has a value.

error.title: Error
error.description: `errorMessage` replaces `helperText`, forces the error border and is announced with role="alert". The counter stays visible.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `isDisabled` locks the field and the resize handle.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three sizes with `size`: sm, md and lg. They change the padding and text size.

borders.title: Borders
borders.description: `border` sets the tone of the border and helper text. It is forced to error when the field is invalid.

tailwind.brandHelper: Secondary accent and radius xl with cn() on wrapperClassName.
tailwind.mergedHelper: radius-xs replaces radius-xl thanks to tailwind-merge.

css.softHelper: No border, soft tertiary background and radius lg, tokens only.

header.title: Textarea API
header.description: API reference for the Textarea React component: props, events, CSS classes, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demo page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath to load only this component.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: It accepts native <textarea> attributes (TextareaHTMLAttributes) except size. Extra attributes, className and style go to the <textarea>; wrapperClassName goes to the container. If you pass rows, it takes precedence over minRows.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.label: The label is linked to the textarea through htmlFor. With no visible label, pass aria-label.
a11y.describedby: helperText or errorMessage is linked through aria-describedby; the error uses role="alert".
a11y.count: The counter is also linked through aria-describedby and uses aria-live="polite" to announce changes.
a11y.states: isInvalid and isRequired are reflected in aria-invalid and aria-required. The asterisk is aria-hidden.
a11y.info: The info icon is a button with a tooltip; infoLabel gives it an accessible name when infoText is not text.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.clear: Clear button. Shown with `clearable` while the field has a value.
rules.label: Field label.
rules.field: Container for the textarea (and the outline label).
rules.footer: Row below the field with the messages and the counter.
rules.messages: Container for the helper or error text.
rules.countLimit: Applied to the counter when it reaches `maxLength`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Textarea defines no variables of its own: it uses gem-system tokens. Redefine them on your `wrapperClassName` to change only this field.

items.--gem-color-accent: Focused border and focused outline label.
items.--gem-color-bg: Textarea background and outline label background.
items.--gem-color-error-600: Required asterisk and invalid outline label.
items.--gem-color-error-700: Error message and counter at the limit.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers. The size, border and label types reuse the InputText ones.

items.placeholder: Sample text when the field is empty.
items.label: Visible field label.
items.labelPlacement: Label position: above or on the border.
items.helperText: Helper text below the field (hidden when `errorMessage` is set).
items.errorMessage: Error message. Marks the field as invalid.
items.infoText: Shows an info icon with this content.
items.infoLabel: Accessible name of the info icon.
items.border: Border tone. Forced to error when the field is invalid.
items.resize: Manual resize, or `auto` to fit the height to the content.
items.minRows: Minimum rows. Also the floor for autosize.
items.showCount: Shows a character counter. Uses `maxLength` when set.
items.maxLength: Native character limit. With `showCount` it shows as current / max.
items.validRegex: Pattern the value must match. An empty value is considered valid.
items.isRequired: Marks the field as required (aria-required + asterisk).
items.clearable: Shows a button that empties the field while it has a value.
items.clearLabel: Accessible name of the clear button.
items.wrapperClassName: Extra classes for the root container.
items.onValidate: Fires when validity changes (and on mount when `validRegex` is set).
items.onInfoClick: Fires when the info icon is activated.
items.onClear: Fires after the field is cleared with the button.
